implementation_policy: Physics: libuipc CUDA IPC solve (physics/simulate.py) of a mandarin orange (affine rigid body on its scanned closed mesh) rolling over a freely laid Baraff-Witkin thin-shell cotton blanket with discrete shell bending, resting on a compressible rooted grass layer modelled as a StableNeoHookean FEM volume; the native metric and dihedral viscosity extension (scripts/pcve_native_viscosity.cu; prebuilt module under tools/ at the repository root, PCVE_NATIVE_RUNTIME overrides) is solved in the same Newton/IPC system. Every case starts from the common accepted warm start, runs dt 1/2400 s for 4 s and is sampled at i/24 s (96 states); edits change only their DSL-resolved parameter (DELETE removes the orange from the solve). The timed edit restores the complete source state of frame 12 from the source cache (--source-cache), doubles the orange's mass and solves on to 4 s; frames 1-11 are the source states. The accepted native states of the whole-clip cases are kept in assets/scenes/picnic_ground_blanket/native/<case>/; a new solve runs on Linux with a CUDA GPU through tools/worker_run.py. Render: Blender 4.3.2 Cycles (appearance/render_replay.py) replays the native cloth vertices and rigid transforms into the packed scene (assets packed_scene.blend), clears its stale shape-key animation and checks the evaluated cloth against the cache within 2 um every frame; grass blades are render proxies that follow the solved support surface, and far_meadow.py continues the same scanned turf to the horizon. appearance/look.py sets the look: Poly Haven CC0 partly cloudy sky with its own sun as a lamp, shade of park trees standing outside the picture, lawn colour variation, gingham cotton with a folded hem, brushed-steel thermos and static border tufts whose layout is derived from the six accepted native states of the asset store. The camera is fixed (scene_manifest.json camera). tools/finalize.py encodes video and masks and exports GT (tools/export_ground_truth.py, pcve_ground_truth/1) from the native state; tools/publish_suite.py assembles renders/pcve_suites/pcve_picnic_ground_blanket_suite with prompts from the builder catalog; tools/verify.py (--stage verify) checks suite videos, prompts and GT against the native inputs. Material parameters are effective values, not calibrated against a measured blanket or lawn.
